_comment: fleet-ops#1222: Weekly Fleet Review quality ratchet (ledger 2026-08-27 | Quality ratchet). Cuts only tighten (down), one notch per week, evidence-based. Loosening requires a Nish ledger waiver. Each knob.cut must equal the live value in quality-routing.json.
_comment_ceilings: fleet-ops#3519: per-repo, per-metric quality ceilings. The Sunday fleet-weekly-review ratchets each ceiling to min(current, observed p50 x 1.1) — it never loosens; loosening needs a PR with a dated reason and Nish's word. Seeds are the measured 2026-09-05 baseline for 0509 (reverts 4.5/100, red-on-main ~6h=360min, sessions-to-PR 33%); metrics without a measured baseline (defects, rework, act-on) seed conservatively-loose so the first ratchet week sets real values. Metrics whose computation is deferred (rework_rate_pct, red_on_main_minutes, review_act_on_rate) carry their seeds now so the shape is complete; separate issues wire their exporters. '_default' covers product repos without their own row until the ratchet gives them one.
